title: Exact Rayleigh Reduction for Direct Detection of Turning Bifurcations
summary: We introduce an exact Rayleigh reduction for the direct construction and detection of turning bifurcations in nonlinear parameter-dependent equations. A generalized Rayleigh functional ordinarily provides only a scalar necessary constraint on solutions. We show that, along a suitable one-parameter transformation orbit $u=\mathcal G_sφ$, it can instead become the exact parameter law $λ=\mathcal R(\mathcal G_sφ)$ of a genuine solution branch.
